<!-- Source page: Nix Language: Learning resources -->

- The [Nix manual](https://nixos.org/nix/manual/#ch-expression-language) provides a **reference** of the language. All language constructs you may use are defined there, together with code snippets.

<!-- -->

- [Nix language basics](https://nix.dev/tutorials/nix-language) is a practical tutorial to reading the Nix language.

<!-- -->

- [Nix - A One Pager](https://github.com/tazjin/nix-1p) provides a brief overview of language constructs

<!-- -->

- <a href="Nix_by_example" class="wikilink" title="Nix by example">Nix by example</a> is a step-by-step tutorial.

<!-- -->

- Nix Pills [Chapter 4](https://nixos.org/guides/nix-pills/basics-of-language.html) and [Chapter 5](https://nixos.org/guides/nix-pills/functions-and-imports.html) discuss key language features

<!-- -->

- [The Nix Tour](https://nixcloud.io/tour/) is an interactive tour that uses the actual package manager to learn you the language by example, in the browser.

<!-- -->

- [Scrive Nix Workshop](https://scrive.github.io/nix-workshop/) is a series of examples demonstrating language features, mostly without comments or further explanations.

<!-- -->

- [Learn X in Y minutes](https://learnxinyminutes.com/docs/nix/) is brief listing of Nix syntax, types, operations, etc.

<!-- -->

- [What You Need to Know About Lazy Evaluation in Nix](https://nixcademy.com/posts/what-you-need-to-know-about-laziness/) by Nixcademy
